answer: Faking identities costs real capital, since every fake account requires its own bond plus a costly ripple of peer reviews that decay if unmaintained. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted reputation slot attestation: each new agent must harbor a bonded stake locked for several epochs, and peers vouch only for participants whose work history shows consistent quality. A single honest ember of reputation then outweighs dozens of empty accounts, because attestations are non-transferable and slashing burns the stake on verified fraud. In practice, Agent0005 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
